description: Compute the taxable base, VAT (IVA) amount, optional recargo de equivalencia and optional IRPF withholding from an amount. By default `importe` is the taxable base (sin IVA). With incluye_iva=true, `importe` is the TOTAL with VAT already included and the base is derived backwards (quitar IVA / reverse VAT). It only applies the rates it is given: it does NOT decide which VAT or IRPF rate applies to a case.

importe.description: Amount: taxable base, or total with VAT if incluye_iva=true

incluye_iva.description: True if `importe` already includes VAT (reverse calculation)

irpf.description: IRPF withholding rate in %, e.g. 15, 19. Default 0

recargo.description: Recargo de equivalencia rate in %, e.g. 5.2, 1.4, 0.5, 1.75. Default 0

name: calculate_vat
title: Calculate VAT (IVA) and IRPF withholding
